description: Offline, FIXED fixture for the grounded-generation faithfulness eval. Each case ships a question, the canned retrieved chunks (with source_url), and a small GOLD answer. The eval replays the chunks through a fake retrieval service so the deterministic provider drafts a grounded answer with no live ES/Qdrant/TEI/Ollama. Citation-accuracy + faithfulness come from the same VerifierAgent production uses; answer-correctness compares the generated answer to the gold answer deterministically (token-overlap F1 via relevance_eval.faithfulness_score). Cases with `injected_answer` bypass the provider and score that exact answer instead — used to prove the gate CATCHES an answer that makes a claim its sources do not support.

cases.query: What is new in ES|QL for join and lookup queries?
cases.gold_answer: ES|QL adds a new LOOKUP JOIN command that enriches rows from an index by joining on a matched field, improving query latency for enrichment workloads compared to the older enrich pipeline approach.

chunks.title: ES|QL release notes
chunks.text: ES|QL adds a new LOOKUP JOIN command that enriches rows from an index by joining on a matched field. The LOOKUP JOIN command improves query latency for enrichment workloads compared to the older enrich pipeline approach.

chunks.title: ES|QL commands
chunks.text: The JOIN command in ES|QL changes execution behavior by streaming matched rows. This matters because moving enrichment into ES|QL reduces the number of pipelines you maintain.

cases.query: What changed for vector search recall and memory in the latest release?
cases.gold_answer: Vector search now improves recall for filtered kNN queries by applying the filter during graph traversal, which reduces memory use for large dense vector indices and lowers query latency for filtered semantic search.

chunks.title: Vector search release notes
chunks.text: Vector search now improves recall for filtered kNN queries by applying the filter during graph traversal. This change reduces memory use for large dense vector indices and lowers query latency for filtered semantic search.
